_comment: Rome Is Displeased (rules 18.n to 18.u): 5 types x 2 = 10. Used cards go to the Rome Is Displeased discard pile (18.l, 18.s).

cards.name: General is Recalled to Rome!
cards.text: No general perks for the current turn and the next one.

cards.name: Emperor confiscates half your Gold!
cards.text: Lose half your Gold (rounded down). With less than 3 Gold you also lose 1 Prestige.

cards.name: Emperor removes you from a Province!
cards.text: Choose a conquered province (never a held Roma) to restore to unconquered and move its troops elsewhere. No Prestige is lost.

cards.name: Emperor steals your troops!
cards.text: Move the bonus troops of this turn to Roma. Nothing happens if you hold Roma.

cards.name: Emperor taxes you!
cards.text: Lose 1 saved card of your choice (2 of your choice with 5 or more saved cards).
